title: NeuronCreatorSchema
description: Simplified schema definition for Neuron Creator configurations and InoLang DSL specifications, restricted strictly to inputs, outputs, and behavioral parameters.

name.description: The unique, fully-qualified name (FQN) of the Neuron.

inputs.description: A list of strongly-typed Synapse names that this Neuron consumes or listens to.

outputs.description: A list of strongly-typed Synapse or Signal names that this Neuron produces or emits.

parameters.description: Arbitrary key-value pairs representing behavioral parameters for customizing the Neuron's execution.
